name: Machine Standing Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from the machine with staggered feet and grasp the handles at chest height.
Rest your back against the pad if provided, brace your trunk and angle your elbows slightly away from your ribs.
Press both handles forward smoothly until your arms are extended in front of your chest.
Control the handles slowly back toward chest level without letting your shoulders roll forward.
tips: Use a staggered stance and tight abs so the resistance does not push you backward.
Keep your wrists straight behind the handles throughout the press.
